newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TV Azteca begins trading on Mexico bourse.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TV Azteca begins trading on Mexico bourse.

text.p: Mexican broadcaster TV Azteca began trading on the Mexican and New York stock exchanges on Friday as part of the company's global initial public offering.
Azteca CPO ordinary shares in Mexico City were placed at an initial price of 35.432 pesos, but quickly rose in early trade to 37.0 pesos, up 4.43 percent. Volume was 349,000 shares.

Azteca placed 345,998,013 shares, or 18.5 percent of the company's share capital, at a value of $526 million. The total value of TV Azteca according to the initial price was $2.85 billion, the company said.
Some 15.7 percent of the shares were placed in Mexico, 59 percent in the United States, and 25.3 percent in Europe.
The IPO was the largest in Mexico since before the 1994 peso crisis, which plunged the economy into crisis.
